snippet.title: Erehwon Trailer Movie loot-driven dungeon crawler RPG
snippet.description:
Add to Wishlist / Demo now available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4008840/Erehwon/

The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. 
Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon-crawling RPG where you progress by rebuilding your character builds based on the gear you acquire.
